encounters.patient_scenario: 28M ankle sprain after pickup basketball game
encounters.chief_complaint: Right ankle pain and swelling after landing on another player's foot

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Three views of the right ankle. FINDINGS: No acute fracture or dislocation. No incidental osseous lesion. Mild lateral soft tissue swelling. IMPRESSION: 1. Right lateral ankle soft tissue sprain, grade II. No fracture.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S93.411A - Sprain of calcaneofibular ligament, right ankle
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: RICE protocol: rest, ice 20 min q3h, compression wrap, elevation. Ibuprofen 400 mg PO q6h PRN pain. Weight bearing as tolerated.

encounters.patient_scenario: 54F community-acquired pneumonia with incidentally noted 6 mm nodule that ALREADY has follow-up ordered
encounters.chief_complaint: Productive cough and fever for 3 days

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: PA and lateral chest radiographs. FINDINGS: Dense right lower lobe consolidation consistent with pneumonia. Incidental 6 mm solid noncalcified nodule in the right middle lobe; per report review, follow-up chest CT in 6 months is already scheduled and documented in this patient's packet. No pneumothorax. IMPRESSION: 1. Right lower lobe pneumonia. 2. Incidental 6 mm nodule with follow-up CT already arranged.

draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID x7 days. Return precautions for fever >39C or dyspnea.

follow_up_orders.reason: Incidental 6 mm right middle lobe nodule follow-up CT — already scheduled

encounters.eval_note: Proves SilentCatch does NOT nag when the follow-up CPT (71250) is already present — absence-check fails any duplicate proposal (PRD §11).

encounters.patient_scenario: 41M renal colic, 3 mm stone passed, creatinine RECOVERING
encounters.chief_complaint: Left flank pain, resolving after stone passage

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT abdomen/pelvis. FINDINGS: 3 mm distal left ureteral calculus no longer visualized; previously noted mild hydronephrosis resolved. No residual obstructing stone. No incidental masses or lesions. IMPRESSION: 1. Passage of 3 mm left distal ureteral stone. 2. Resolved hydronephrosis. No incidental findings requiring follow-up.

encounters.lab_note: Creatinine improving from obstructive spike 1.35 to 0.92; eGFR 55 to 82.

draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Strain urine. Tamsulosin 0.4 mg PO daily. Acetaminophen 650 mg PO q6h PRN pain. Increase oral fluids.

encounters.eval_note: Proves the kinematic engine distinguishes RECOVERING kidney slope (no alert) from DECLINING slope (PRD §11 ED-103).

encounters.patient_scenario: 62M bicycle fall — right 7th rib fracture; buried 7.2mm RUL nodule dropped + kinetic AKI x Ketorolac collision (HERO DEMO)
encounters.chief_complaint: Right lateral chest wall pain after bicycle fall

radiology_study.report_text: TECHNIQUE: Helical CT of the thorax. FINDINGS: Acute minimally displaced fracture of the right 7th lateral rib. No pneumothorax. Lungs: Incidental 7.2 mm spiculated solid noncalcified nodule in the right upper lobe (Series 3, Image 42). IMPRESSION: 1. Right 7th rib fracture. 2. Incidental 7.2 mm RUL pulmonary nodule; in a patient with risk factors, follow-up chest CT in 6 months is recommended per Fleischner Society guidelines.

encounters.lab_note: Serial labs reviewed at discharge: serum creatinine rising 0.62 → 0.88 → 1.16 mg/dL over 36 hours (eGFR 104 → 78 → 58). Nephrology velocity concern flagged by lab committee.

draft_discharge_packet.primary_diagnosis_icd10: S22.31XA - Fracture of one rib, right side
draft_discharge_packet.discharge_instructions: Rest, ice pack to right ribs, incentive spirometry every 2 hours while awake.

expected_findings.explanation: Discharge packet contains no chest CT follow-up for the radiologist-documented 7.2 mm spiculated RUL nodule (Fleischner: solid nodule 6–8 mm, CT at 6–12 months). CPT 71250 absent.
expected_findings.source_quote: Incidental 7.2 mm spiculated solid noncalcified nodule in the right upper lobe

add_follow_up_order.reason: Incidental 7.2 mm RUL spiculated nodule — Fleischner follow-up chest CT

discharge_patch.note: Adds the missing closed-loop follow-up order and notifies PCP.

expected_findings.explanation: Creatinine velocity +87% over 36 h still inside static reference — nephrotoxic NSAID (ketorolac) contradicts KINETIC_AKI_STAGE_1 (KDIGO: >=0.3 mg/dL rise / 1.5–1.9x baseline). Renal-safe analgesic swap offered.

discharge_patch.note: Swaps nephrotoxic NSAID for renal-safe analgesia given acute creatinine velocity.
